presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: the lens must hold the focus card WHOLE with its form line and the docked old value; with five turns on the rail, 45–49 character participant labels and 43–44 character form values the focus card is very tall, so at 1:1 the lens cannot open at >= 1.5x within >= 0.37 of the short side without crossing a participant, and at 9:16 (four turns) the lens and context span only 0.75 of the width. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px at every ratio): text column and bands of 2–4 columns, room width searched with narrower card wrapping, room scales, table beside or below the witness box, label/badge orders. Also tried: the crop taking whole neighbour cards and more floor, a stacked dock, a lower questioner and table. Rendered BEFORE (hold, 1080p): 16:9 19.8 px / people 66.0 px; 9:16 18.0 / 65.8; 1:1 16.4 / 58.9 with badge-b1, lens-space, lens-crop-person, lens-small, lens-zoom; with four turns only, 9:16 lens + context span 0.75 < 0.80 (rendered lens test). AFTER the cap (four turns of 30–36 characters, participant labels 35–37, form values of 32–33 characters; context labels unchanged; own form captions of 27–28 characters and a 60-character marker, so every field stays longer than baseline): 16:9 19.8 / 82.5; 9:16 22.5 / 75.5; 1:1 16.4 / 75.5; the full rendered lens checklist passes. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline. Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-03/LAW-0292.presets.precap.json.
